parsed.summary: The patch addresses the two-digit year issue correctly but introduces potential regressions and lacks tests.

issues.description: The patch may break existing behavior for timestamps that are exactly 50 years in the future or within the next 50 years.
No new tests are added to verify the correctness of the patch.
The code becomes slightly less readable due to the introduction of additional variables and logic.
